text:
priya_support: raising to eng — AcmeCorp reporting repeated 502s + 'request queue depth exceeded' errors starting ~09:02 PST. p95 latency up to 12s. customer is impacted 

jordan_cust: seeing 502s on POST to https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate, trace ids: acme-1, acme-2. No auth or billing alerts on our side.

matt_eng: can you paste a minimal repro curl and any x-request-id values?

jordan_cust: repro curl:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-ACME123'
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
  -d '{"model":"gpt-large-rasp","input":"hello world","max_tokens":1024}'
```

priya_support: set sev=sev3. no billing flags. initial suspicion: request queue saturation / continuous-batcher backlog. grafana: https://grafana.company/boards/queue-depth?panel=acme

sarah_sre: confirmed spike at 09:01:55 — queue depth jumped and dequeue rate dropped for ~40s. metric cbatcher.pending_batches spiked. looks like a hotspot on the model pool causing long tail latencies.

matt_eng: please run a quick probe on eng-runtime: dump batcher queue and tail logs for model gpt-large-rasp on pool dedicated-prod-1. specifically want kernel latency and kv-cache miss rates. if kv misses + long kernel schedules, fallback to a smaller model or different pool.

casey_prod: routing policy has a fallback to model-compact but EU capacity was already saturated. I can apply a temporary routing override to send Acme traffic to us-east-spare. approve?

priya_support: yes, apply for 5m and monitor. also ask customer to retry with max_tokens:128 to help repro.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: routing override applied -> AcmeCorp -> us-east-spare (expires in 5m) :white_check_mark:

matt_eng: collecting logs now. early findings: tokenize_time and kernel_latency p95 elevated on multiple hosts. sample log snippet: 
```
{'host':'gpu-23','trace':'acme-1','kernel_latency_ms':182}
```

sarah_sre: mitigation plan: 1) route to spare pool (done) 2) ask client to lower max_tokens 3) scale up dedicated-prod-1 by +1 node if sustained >15s. I kicked an autoscale request.

jordan_cust: routing change reduced errors immediately, thanks. sending full logs by DM.

matt_eng: follow-ups: add early-reject guard returning 429 + Retry-After when queue depth > threshold, and alert on cbatcher.pending_batches > 200. I'll open a PR for the guard and dashboard alerts.

priya_support: creating ticket INC-4532 and looping in account team for SLA note. scheduling post-mortem if we see recurrence.

casey_prod: noted. will keep override window and prepare rollback plan.

sarah_sre: monitoring dashboard. will close thread after 1h of stable p95.

priya_support: thanks team :thumbsup:
